label: GO: choosing a1 right after a rewarded trial (mid-episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never at D1 or D2), only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew was 1 at D1), and almost only when the agent is about to choose a1 (33553 of 33557 activations; every activation has policy logit a1-a2 > 8, i.e. a confident a1 choice). The only FUTURE variable used is action, which at GO is the agent own upcoming choice; it can be swapped for the policy logit (choice > 8.07 gives recall 1.0, precision 0.29). Since the previous reward is nearly always for a1 (77% of mass has previous a1-common; the rest are first-trial windows where tv is unknown), it is effectively a rewarded-a1, stay-on-a1 signal and is 84% within S1-good blocks. Strong episode-time gating: silent in ep trials 0-2 and after about trial 80, peak in trials 10-50; adding this bound raises dev F1 from 0.45 to 0.55 at recall 0.98. Precision stays about 0.38: many rewarded a1-repeats do not activate. Magnitude is higher when the model value is high (value > 7.54 holds 86% of mass) and within long reward runs often peaks a couple of trials in and then decays, but I found no simple predicate for which repeats fire. Never fires after unrewarded trials, before a2 choices, or at D1/D2.
